fields.label: Ca Certificate
fields.help: The CA certificate on the external server.

fields.label: Client Certificate
fields.help: The client certificate on the external server.

fields.label: Client Key
fields.help: The private key file for the client certificate on the external server.

fields.label: Database Version
fields.help: The MySQL, PostgreSQL or SQL Server (beta) version to use.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Dump File Path
fields.help: A file in the bucket that contains the data from the external server.

fields.label: Host
fields.help: The IPv4 address and port for the external server, or the the DNS address for the external server.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: The name of the source representation instance.

fields.label: Password
fields.help: The password for the replication user account.

fields.label: Port
fields.help: The externally accessible port for the source database server.

fields.label: Region
fields.help: The Region in which the created instance should reside.

fields.label: Username
fields.help: The replication user account on the external server.
